name: @gillcash/necktie
description: The angel of late-stage capitalism for your AI agent, with useful Full and unrebutted Mammon modes.

scripts.build:adapters: npm run build:policy && node scripts/build-adapters.js && node scripts/build-openclaw-skills.js
scripts.check:adapters: npm run check:policy && node scripts/build-adapters.js --check && node scripts/build-openclaw-skills.js --check
scripts.test: npm run check:adapters && npm run check:versions && node --test tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix pi-extension && npm test --prefix necktie-mcp && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
